title.zh: 将巴科洛德市陆运署（LTO）牌照延伸办公室改设为正式牌照中心，名称为西内格罗斯牌照中心，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Licensing Extension Office in Bacolod City Into a Regular Licensing Center to Be Known as the Negros Occidental Licensing Center, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Converting the Land Transportation Office (LTO) Licensing Extension Office in Bacolod City Into a Regular Licensing Center to Be Known as the Negros Occidental Licensing Center, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi Văn phòng mở rộng Land Transportation Office Licensing tại Thành phố Bacolod thành Regular Licensing Center với tên gọi Negros Occidental Licensing Center, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนสถานะสำนักงานขยาย Land Transportation Office Licensing ในเมือง Bacolod เป็น Regular Licensing Center ในชื่อ Negros Occidental Licensing Center และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Kantor Perluasan Land Transportation Office Licensing di Kota Bacolod menjadi Regular Licensing Center dengan nama Negros Occidental Licensing Center, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menukar status Pejabat Lanjutan Land Transportation Office Licensing di Bandar Bacolod kepada Regular Licensing Center dengan nama Negros Occidental Licensing Center, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

text.en: Conversion into a Regular Licensing Center. - The Land Transportation Office (LTO) Licensing Extension Office in Bacolod City is hereby converted into a regular licensing center to be known as the Negros Occidental Licensing Center.

Appropriations. - The Secretary of Transportation shall immediately include in the Department's program the operationalization of the Negros Occidental Licensing Center in the City of Bacolod, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
